senses.gloss:
विध् 1. विध् (= rt. विथ्), cl. 1. A. वे-
धते, वेधितुम्, to ask, beg.

विध् 2. विध् (thought by some to have
been developed out of वि-धा and rt.
व्यध्), cl. 6. P. विधति, विवेध, वेधिष्यति,
अवेधीत्, वेधितुम्, to dispose (Ved.); to perform
(Ved.); to administer, govern, rule, command; to wor-
ship, honour, sacrifice; to pierce, (in this sense for rt.
व्यध्): Caus. वेधयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अवीविधत्:
Desid. विविधिषति and विवेधिषति: Intens. वे-
विध्यते, वेविधीति, वेवेद्धि.

3. विध् (fr. rt. व्यध्), piercing, penetrating (at
the end of comps., cf. हृदय-व्˚).

4. विध्, cl. 1. A. विन्धते, &c., Ved. to be
deprived of.

1. विध, अस्, आ, m. f. (more properly fr. rt. व्यध्),
piercing, penetrating, penetration. (For 2. वि-ध
see under वि-धा, col. 2.)

2. वि-ध, अस्, m. form, manner, measure, kind, sort
(often at the end of comps., see एवं-व्˚, तथा-व्˚,
द्वि-व्˚, बहु-व्˚, &c.); fold (at the end of comps.,
especially after numerals, see अष्ट-व्˚, सप्त-व्˚);
the food of elephants; prosperity; (आ), f. form,
formula, rule; manner, kind, sort; act, action; doing
well, prosperity, affluence; wages, hire; fodder, the
food of elephants, horses, &c.; [cf. Old Pruss. wida-s,
wid-s, sta-wida-s, sta-wids, ‘of such sort;’ ka-
wid-s (fem. ka-wida), ‘of which kind;’ kitta-
widin, kitte-widei, ‘in any way.’]

विधा वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते,
-धातुम्, to distribute, apportion, bestow, grant; to
procure, furnish; to give out, diffuse; to extend (Ved.);
to put in order, arrange, regulate, dispose, make ready,
prepare, attend to; to prescribe, ordain, direct, enjoin,
settle, fix; to appoint, commission, depute; to place
on, put on or in, put down, lay down, lay aside; to
place, put, lay (in general); to hold, possess, assume,
take; to form, build, create; to perform, effect,
accomplish, produce, establish, cause, occasion, render,
make, do, act, act towards, treat as, (these senses
may be almost endlessly modified by using वि-धा,
like कृ, in connection with various nouns, e. g. सिं-
हत्वं विधा, to change into a lion; कामं वि-
धा, to fulfil a wish; वृत्तिं विधा, to fix a liveli-
hood or maintenance; हृदये विधा, to lay to
heart; शस्त्राणि विधा, to lay down arms; मन्त्रं
विधा, to hold a consultation; राज्यं विधा, to
carry on a government, rule; पूजां विधा, to do
honour to, show respect to, worship; शौचं विधा,
to perform purification; लज्जां विधा, to display
bashfulness; मैत्र्यं विधा, to make friendship;
सन्धिं विधा, to conclude peace; कलहं विधा,
to pick a quarrel; वैरं विधा, to declare war; को-
लाहलं विधा, to raise a clamour; तं नृपं
विदधुः, they made him king): Pass. -धीयते,
to be distributed or apportioned; to be arranged or
attended to; to be prescribed or settled, &c.; to
be taken or reckoned for, &c.: Caus. -धापयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to put in order or arrange or fix;
to cause to put, cause to be laid: Desid. -धित्सति,
-ते, to wish to distribute or bestow, to wish to arrange,
try to fix; to wish or intend to do or perform or
accomplish or effect; to wish to render, &c.

विधत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. worshipping,
honouring.

विधन वि-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of
wealth, having no riches, poor.
—विधन-ता, f.
destitution, poverty.

वि-धान, अम्, n. the act of arranging, disposing,
prescribing, enjoining, ordering, performing, making;
[]
arrangement, disposition, creation; act, action, (espe-
cially) the performance of prescribed acts or rites; rule,
precept, ordinance, injunction, regulation, sacred text;
act of worship, rite, ceremony; form, formula, mode,
method, manner, (तथा-व्˚, following such a mode
or method); means, expedient; gaining, obtaining,
taking, possessing; wealth; act of hostility; conflict
of opposite feelings; an elephant's fodder; (in gram-
mar) affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c.; (अस्,
आ, अम्), acting, performing, possessing, assuming,
wearing, having.
—विधान-ग, अस्, m. ‘rule-goer,’
a Paṇḍit, a wise or learned man, teacher.
—विधान-
ज्ञ, अस्, m. one who knows rules or rites, a Paṇḍit,
wise man.
—विधान-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable
to rule, conformable to sacred precept.

विधर्तृ वि-धर्तृ, वि-धर्मन्, &c. See
under वि-धृ, p. 922, col. 2.

वि-धर्तृ, ता, m., Ved. one who supports, a sup-
porter, bearer, sustainer (= विधारयितृ, Nirukta
XII. 14); the performer of various functions, (Sāy.
= विविध-कारक.)
विधवन वि-धवन, &c. See p. 922, col. 1.

वि-धवन, अम्, n. the act of shaking about,
agitation, trembling.

विधवा वि-धवा, f. (see 2. धव), a hus-
bandless woman, a widow; [cf. Lat. vidua, vi-
duus; Goth. viduvo; Angl. Sax. wuduwe, wu-
duwa; Slav. vidova; Hib. feadhb; perhaps Gr.
ἠΐθεος.]
—विधवा-गामिन्, ई, m. one who has in-
tercourse with a widow.
—विधवा-धर्म, अस्,
m. ‘the duty of widows,’ N. of a section of the
Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—विधवावेदन (˚वा-आव्˚), अम्,
n. marrying a widow.
वि-धस्, आस्, m., N. of Brahmā; [cf. वेधस्.]

वि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done according to
rule, to be observed (as a rite or ceremony); to be
prescribed or regulated; to be done or performed or
effected.

वि-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, arranging, disposing, mak-
ing, creating; = मेधाविन् (according to Naigh. III.
15); (ता), m. an arranger, disposer, maker, creator;
N. of Brahmā (as creator of the world); N. of Viśva-
karman; fate, destiny; N. of Kāma (god of love);
of a son of Bhṛgu; of a son of Viṣṇu and Lakṣmī;
spirituous liquor; (त्री), f. long pepper.
—विधातृ-
भू, ऊस्, m. ‘son of Brahmā,’ epithet of Nārada,
(see नारद.)
—विधातृ-वशात्, ind. from the will
of Brahmā; through the power of fate or destiny.
—विधात्रायुस् (˚तृ-आय्˚), उस्, m. the sunflower;
sunshine, (according to Śabda-k. = सूर्य-शोभा.)

वि-धानक, अस्, आ, अम्, disposing, arranging,
one who knows how to arrange; (अम्), n. affliction,
distress, pain (= व्यथा).

वि-धायक, अस्, इका, अम्, disposing, arranging,
performing; consigning, delivering, one who entrusts
or deposits anything or causes it to be fixed or secure.
—विधायक-त्व, अम्, n. consignment or delivery
of anything, making anything firm or secure.

वि-धायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, disposing, arranging; mak-
ing, forming, building; causing, occasioning; placing,
fixing, securing; delivering, entrusting; establishing
a rule or law.

वि-धास्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, wishing or pur-
posing to arrange; intending to direct or enjoin or
prescribe, wishing to make or do or perform, &c.

वि-धि, इस्, m. a rule, form, formula, sacred pre-
cept, injunction, rubric, sacred text or scripture, text
prescribing any act or observance, order, command,
ordinance, statute, law, direction for the performance
of a rite as given in the Brāhmaṇa portion of the
Veda, (according to Sāy. the Brāhmaṇa consists of
two parts, 1. Vidhi or commandment, e. g. यजेत,
he ought to sacrifice; कुर्यात्, he ought to perform;
2. Artha-vāda or explanatory statements as to the
origin of rites and use of the Mantras, mixed up with
legends and illustrations), any prescribed act or rite or
ceremony, an act or action in general, behaviour, con-
duct, mode of life, method, manner, way, means;
kind, sort; creation; the creator; N. of Brahmā;
of Viṣṇu; fate, destiny, luck; time; fodder, food
for elephants or horses; a physician; (इस्), f., N. of
a goddess.
—विधि-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘rule-destroy-
ing,’ one who deviates from or disregards rules, dis-
turbing modes of proceeding.
—विधि-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘rule-knowing,’ one who knows the prescribed
mode or form; learned in ritual; (अस्), m. a Brāhman
who knows the ritual, a ritualist.
—विधि-तस्, ind.
according to rule.
—विधि-दर्शक, अस्, or विधि-
दर्शिन्, ई, m. ‘rule-shower,’ a priest whose business
is to see that everything at a sacrifice is done accord-
ing to prescribed rules and to correct any deviation
from them.
—विधि-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, prescribed
or approved by rule.
—विधि-देशक, अस्, m. ‘rule-
shower,’ a priest who corrects errors at a sacrifice.
—वि-
धि-द्वैध, अम्, n. diversity of rule, variance of rite.
—विधि-पर्यागत, अस्, आ, अम्, come into possession
through destiny.
—विधि-पूर्वकम्, ind. after due
observance of rule, according to rule.
—विधि-प्र-
युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, performed according to rule.
—विधि-प्रयोग, अस्, m. the application of a rule,
acting according to rule.
—विधि-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, m.
application of a rule, acting upon a rule.
—विधि-
यज्ञ, अस्, m. a ceremonial act of worship.
—विधि-
योग, अस्, m. the occurrence of fated or predestined
events; combining for any act or rite.
—विधि-र-
सायन, N. of a work by Appayya Dīkṣita (con-
futing the Mīmāṃsā as expounded by Bhaṭṭa Kumā-
rila).
—विधि-वत्, ind. agreeably to rule, according to
law, in due form, conformably to established ordinances.
—विधि-वधू, ऊस्, f. ‘wife of Brahmā,’ epithet of
Sarasvatī.
—विधि-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, established by
rule, prescribed by law.
—विधि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्,
destitute of rule, unauthorised, irregular.
वि-धित्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, = वि-धित्समान below.

वि-धित्सा, f. the wish to arrange; desire to do or
make; design, purpose, desire.
वि-धित्सित, अम्, n. design, purpose, intention.

वि-धित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to arrange; intending
to make; purposing to perform.

वि-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being arranged, being
enjoined, being defined, &c.

वि-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arranged or prescribed;
to be enjoined (as a rule &c.); to be performed or
practised or done; liable to be ruled or governed or
influenced by, governable, subject to; compliant, sub-
missive, tractable.
—विधेय-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing
what ought to be done.
—विधेय-ता, f. or विधेय-
त्व, अम्, n. fitness to be prescribed or enjoined; fitness
for enactment (as a rule or law), necessary or proper
act or conduct; tractableness, docility, submission.
—विधेय-पद, अम्, n. an object to be accom-
plished.
—विधेय-मार्ग, अस्, m. the seeking to
do a necessary act.
—विधेयात्मन् (˚य-आत्˚), आ, m.
‘having a well-governed nature,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.

विधाव् 1. वि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति,
-ते, -धावितुम्, to run or flow through, flow off (as
water), to percolate or trickle through, flow away; to
run or flee away (in disorder), be dispersed; to run
through; to rush upon.

विधाव् 2. वि-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति,
-ते, -धावितुम्, to wash off, wash away, cleanse off.

वि-धावत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running away, running
through.
वि-धौत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed by washing.

विधु 1. विधु, उस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
I. 24. fr. rt. व्यध्, ‘to pierce,’ because the moon
pierces the absent with sorrowful feelings; more pro-
bably connected with rt. 2. विध् or with वि-धा), one
who arranges or disposes or rules or maintains (Ved.);
the moon; N. of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; a Rākṣasa,
fiend; an expiatory oblation; camphor.
—विधु-
क्षय, अस्, m. the wane of the moon, the dark
days of the month.
—विधुन्-तुद, अस्, m. ‘moon-
troubler,’ epithet of Rāhu or the personified ascend-
ing Node (causing the moon's eclipses).
—विधु-
पञ्जर, अस्, m. a scimitar, sabre.
—विधु-प्रिया,
f. ‘dear to the moon,’ a lunar mansion or Nakṣatra
(personified as a nymph, the daughter of Dakṣa and
wife of the Moon, see नक्षत्र).
विधु 2. वि-धु = वि-धू below.

विधू वि-धू, cl. 5. P. A. -धूनोति, -धूनुते
(later also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), cl. 6. P. -धुवति,
-धवितुम्, -धोतुम्, to shake about, move to and fro,
agitate, excite, wave about, toss about; to shake off,
drive away, disperse, remove, destroy; to shake off
from one's self, relinquish, abandon, leave off (A.);
to fan, agitate by blowing: Pass. -धूयते, to be
shaken about, to be waved about, to be fanned, &c.:
Caus. -धूनयति, -यितुम्, to cause to shake about,
shake violently, agitate, cause to stagger.

विधुर, अस्, आ, अम् (probably fr. rt. व्यध्, cf. वि-
थुर), agitated, troubled, distressed, bewildered, con-
fused (with fear, liquor, &c.), trembling; suffering se-
paration or absence from a mistress or lover, being in
a state of bereavement, abandoned; adverse, hostile;
(अस्), m. a widower; (अम्), n. agitation of mind,
anxiety, alarm, terror; danger; separation from a
mistress or lover; (आ), f. curds mixed with sugar
and spices.
—विधुर-ता, f. a state of agitation or
trouble of mind, state of trepidation or alarm.
—वि-
धुर-दर्शन, अम्, n. the sight of anything alarm-
ing; a feeling of agitation or uneasiness.
विधुर; according to B. R. fr. rt. 4. विध् above.
वि-धुर, अस्, आ, अम्, without a pole or axle-peg.
वि-धव्य, अम्, n. agitation, trembling, tremor.

वि-धाव्य, अम्, n. agitation, shaking about, tre-
pidation.

वि-धुत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about; shaken off,
driven away; abandoned, relinquished, left off.
—वि-
धुत-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, released from bonds.

वि-धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken or tossed about,
waved, waving; trembling, tremulous; unsteady;
shaken off, dispelled, removed; abandoned; (अम्),
n. the repelling of affection, repugnance.
—विधूत-
कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, having sin dispelled or re-
moved, delivered from sin.
—विधूत-केश, अस्, आ,
अम्, who or what has tossed about the hair (Kirāt.
VIII. 33).
—विधूत-निद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, roused
from sleep, awakened.
वि-धुति, इस्, f. shaking, trembling, trepidation.
वि-धूति, इस्, f. agitation, tremor; shaking.

वि-धुनन, अम्, n. the act of shaking or tossing
about, trembling, tremor.

वि-धूनन, अम्, n. causing to shake or tremble,
shaking, trembling, tremor.

वि-धुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, shaking, tossing about,
waving about.
वि-धुन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking about, tossing.

वि-धुवत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, shaking or waving
about, brandishing.
वि-धुवन, अम्, n. trembling, tremor.
वि-धूनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, violently shaking.

वि-धूनित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, tossed
about, agitated, alarmed; harassed, annoyed.

वि-धूय, ind. having shaken about, having
shaken off, having removed, &c.

वि-धूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being shaken, being
agitated or waved about.

वि-धूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being shaken, being
agitated, being waved about.
विधूम वि-धूम, अस्, आ, अम्, smokeless.
वि-धूम, अस्, आ, अम्, free from smoke or vapour.

विधृ वि-धृ, cl. 10. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्,
to keep asunder, keep apart, separate, divide, distri-
bute; to arrange; to manage; to keep off; to lay hold
of, seize; to keep back, withhold, restrain, obstruct;
to hold up, bear, carry, support, maintain, sustain,
preserve, take care of; to keep fixed, (with मनस्,
to fix the mind upon.)

वि-धर्मन्, अ, n., Ved. the function of support-
ing (the universe); various function or office; bear-
ing, supporting; epithet of the sky (as the bearer of
light and rain); epithet of the vessel used in the pre-
paration of the Soma juice; order, rule, right, might.

वि-धार, अस्, m., Ved. bearing, supporting; epi-
thet of the sky (as the bearer of rain and light).

वि-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, kept asunder or apart,
separated; seized, grasped, held; taken, assumed,
possessed; withheld, restrained, (अ-विधृत, unre-
strained, unchecked); (अम्), n. disregard of an
injunction or wish; dissatisfaction.
—विधृतायुध
(˚त-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, holding weapons.

वि-धृति, इस्, f. arrangement, rule, regulation,
ordinance.

विधृष् वि-धृष्, Caus. -धर्षयति, -यि-
तुम्, to violate, ravish; to spoil, injure; to annoy,
trouble.

विध्मा वि-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मा-
तुम्, to blow away, blow off; to scatter, disperse,
destroy.
विध्यत् विध्यत्, &c. See under rt. व्यध्.

विध्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, piercing, perforating;
stabbing, striking, wounding, killing.

विध्वंस् वि-ध्वंस् or वि-ध्वस्, cl. 1. A.
-ध्वंसते (ep. also P. -ति), -ध्वंसितुम्, to fall
to pieces, crumble into dust or powder; to be scat-
tered or whirled about (like dust), be dispersed; to
be destroyed, perish: Caus. -ध्वंसयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to fall to pieces or crumble, dash to pieces,
crush, destroy, annihilate; to injure.

वि-ध्वंस, अस्, m. falling to pieces, ruin, de-
struction; aversion, disrespect, enmity, dislike; in-
sult, offence.

वि-ध्वंसमान, अस्, आ, अम्, falling or crumbling
to pieces.

वि-ध्वंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, dashed or broken to
pieces, destroyed.

वि-ध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling to pieces, falling
asunder, being scattered or dispersed, falling down,
being ruined, perishing; causing to fall, ruining,
destroying; hostile, adverse.

वि-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen asunder, fallen to
pieces, destroyed, ruined, scattered about or tossed
up, whirled up (as dust); obscured, darkened, oblite-
rated, eclipsed (in astronomy).
—विध्वस्त-नग-
राश्रम (˚र-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having ruined cities
and hermitages.
—विध्वस्त-पर-गुण, अस्, m.
one who detracts from the merits of another.

वीध्र वीध्र, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s.
II. 26. fr. rt. इन्ध् with वि), clear, clean, pure; (अम्),
n. the sky, atmosphere; wind; fire; [cf. Gr. αἰθρία.]

विध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pierced or struck
or wounded.
वि-धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, quite grey.
